message: 天と地が喰らう勝負

name: Lolotte
message: 「Listen carefully, Ms. Extra. First, I, Lolotte Rosenkreuz, shall explain what Student Council activities are all about--」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey, Prez. Let's go hang out somewhere~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hey~~! Please listen to what I'm saying!」

name: Sally
message: 「No way, bleh」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wh-wh-wh-what is with that ridiculous attitude?!」

name: Sally
message: 「I mean, Lolo-chi is just a lowly underling in the Student Council, right? Totally pointless to listen to」

name: Lolotte
message: 「H-How could you~」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now. Lolotte isn't an underling at all. She's a proper Student Council secretary, after all」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right, ahem」

name: Sally
message: 「Don't puff out a chest you don't have, it's embarrassing」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I don't want to hear that from Ms. Extra~~」

name: Sally
message: 「A woman isn't judged by the size of her chest! It's all about sex appeal, ooh-la-la~\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, what should we do today?」

name: Sally
message: 「Ahh-ha~n\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Lolotte. Have any volunteer requests come in?」

name: Sally
message: 「--Hey, don't ignore me!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Today... Oh my. There's one from the Chairwoman.」

name: Synn
message: 「From Helena-san? She didn't mention anything earlier」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. It was actually just sent a moment ago.」

name: Synn
message: 「It might be urgent. Let's take a look right away」

name: Lolotte
message: 「'Greetings, members of the Student Council'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「'About the girl I brought in earlier--she was wearing her outdoor shoes inside, so the hallway is probably super dirty'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「'Sorry to bother you, but please clean it up. From your beloved BOSS'」

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan, wait...」

name: Misa
message: 「She's floating, so 'tracking mud inside' doesn't even apply」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I bet that's it! They just wanted an excuse--an excuse to dump the cleaning on us!!」

name: Ria
message: 「'Hmph, do you really need a reason every time you fight?'」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Regardless of the reason, since we were asked, we must see it through. That is the mission bestowed upon us!」

name: Ria
message: 「Since we're already at it, let's clean the Student Council room together too」
And so, Lolotte, Sally-chan, and I ended up in charge of the hallway.

name: Sally
message: 「Yeehaw!!」
Sally-chan is using a mop like skates and sliding all around the hallway.

name: Synn
message: 「Heeey, that's dangerous~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That's right! Besides, you mustn't run in the hallw--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Kyaa!?」
Even Lolotte, who usually looks like she's about to trip without actually falling, loses her footing on the freshly mopped floor.

name: Sally
message: 「Pfft, so lame~」
She turns around and laughs at Lolotte's pathetic state.

name: Synn
message: 「Sally-chan, behind you, behind you!」

name: Sally
message: 「Gah!!」
Not watching where she's going, she crashes straight into the wall.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Uuu... That hurts...」

name: Sally
message: 「Kyuru~n\s07」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Good grief... Every bit of this is that careless, reckless Omake-san's fault.」

name: Sally
message: 「What did you say!? For an angel, you sure blame everything on me~」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, whoa, stop fighting. Both of you, cut it out. At this rate, we'll never finish cleaning.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This, that, the other, and everything else is all because Omake-san refuses to take things seriously!」

name: Sally
message: 「You're one to talk, Lolo-chii--you've been doing nothing but flapping your gums this whole time~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There's a proper order to doing things, you know!」

name: Sally
message: 「We only move our mouths when we're eating yummy food! That's what makes us the 'Delicious Food Squad~♪'」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Then let's do this. Let's have a contest to see who can clean the most thoroughly.」

name: Sally
message: 「A contest?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're sounding kind of like the Vice President.」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't lump me in with him!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Our dueling ground is this hallway, overflowing with the chaos of filth. We'll compete to see who can restore peace to this corridor the fastest.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「And what happens if we win?」

name: Synn
message: 「The losers have to obediently do whatever the winner says.」

name: Sally
message: 「Ooh, I like that! That means Prez and Rolochi will become my slaves, ushishishi」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're supposed to say lines like that after you win. I'm going to work you and the tagalong here to the bone, Prez~」
Flames ignite in both of their eyes.

name: Synn
message: 「Yep. Pretty great idea, if I do say so myself. With this, the two of them--」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on a second!! Why am I being counted as one of the competitors too?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh heh... Trying to get away without getting your own hands dirty--classic you.」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, how evil. I was planning on doing my fair share too, you know!」

name: Sally
message: 「Bring it on!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Gladly!」
No, not the competition--the cleaning.

name: Synn
message: 「Grrr... Looks like I really have no choice but to do this...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, Mr. Panda. Please act as our referee.」

name: Sally
message: 「No playing favorites, got it? Keep it fair, FAIR!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Alright. Just make sure you scrub your own turf until it sparkles. On your marks... ready, start!!」
Everyone starts cleaning the hallway all at once.

name: Paqy
message: 「Time's up!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ehh, that was so fast~~」

name: Sally
message: 「Pfft, 'I didn't have enough time' won't fly as an excuse~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Th-th-that's not it!」

name: Synn
message: 「Phew--. Guess I barely made it in time.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh, I have a feeling this is going to be a close match.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well now. First, I'll judge Flatty.」

name: Sally
message: 「Stop calling me Flatty!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Ho, looks like you wet-mopped the whole hallway.」

name: Sally
message: 「I did it super fast! That's a total V-sign for victory!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Except it's still soaking wet and hasn't been dry-wiped. Minus points.」

name: Sally
message: 「Booo! Why?!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, Master Synn. Try walking over there.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm? Sure, I don't mind--

name: Synn
message: Aaaah!」

name: Paqy
message: 「If you don't wipe it properly, that's what happens.」

name: Sally
message: 「I went through all the trouble of cleaning it, so don't get it dirty!!」

name: Synn
message: 「What a harsh thing to say」

name: Paqy
message: 「Now then, next is Angel.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A-a-angel?! I'm no angel!」

name: Paqy
message: 「This was wiped down pretty carefully with a cloth.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How do you like that, Miss Bonus? This is what you call a difference in class.」

name: Sally
message: 「Grrr, I'm not even frustrated or anything!」

name: Paqy
message: 「However, there's still dirt left in the four corners. Someone must've fed you useless advice, huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The guidebook said to wipe in a circular motion, though」

name: Paqy
message: 「Corners are where dirt builds up the fastest. That's how the world gets more and more defiled. Minus points」

name: Lolotte
message: 「H-How could you~」

name: Sally
message: 「Pfft, told you so」

name: Paqy
message: 「And finally, Master Synn--now *this* is what cleaning is all about!」

name: Sally
message: 「What's that supposed to mean?! That's favoritism!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Just because he's the President's pet doesn't mean you can cheat!」

name: Paqy
message: 「From sweeping to mopping. Removing stains and stubborn grime, and then applying wax once the floor is dry」

name: Synn
message: 「Putting down a coat of wax makes it harder for dirt to stick, you know~」

name: Paqy
message: 「Look at the dividing line between his area and yours. It's a gorgeous two-tone contrast, isn't it」

name: Paqy
message: 「Cleaning was his specialty to begin with, after all. The winner of this match is Master Synn」

name: Sally
message: 「It's your fault for getting in my way, Lolo-chi!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「You're the one who got in *my* way, Ms. Extra!」

name: Synn
message: 「Okay, okay, settle down. The losers have to do whatever the winner says, right」

name: Sally
message: 「Grrr, how humiliating!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I wanted to savor the taste of victory......」

name: Synn
message: 「In that case, you two make up」

name: Sally
message: 「Huh?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Is that... all?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yup. I'll teach you how to clean, so let's all work together and get the rest of this place spotless」

name: Sally
message: 「All right, Lolo-chi. I won't lose next time!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'll beat you right back!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, I just said we don't need to compete anymore\s01」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Synn, are you done~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. How about on your end?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「All good. And guess what, Senpai says she'll treat us to tea and snacks」

name: Synn
message: 「Way to go, Senpai」

name: Sally
message: 「Yay, snacks~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I won't let you get a head start on me~~」

name: Synn
message: 「Slurp... Phew」

name: Nanaka
message: 「A cup after work really hits the spot!」

name: Ria
message: 「Here you go, today we have dorayaki with mochi inside」

name: Sally
message: 「Mine!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hey, that one's mine!」

name: Synn
message: 「Mmm~~. Ahem!」

name: Sally
message: 「*Jolt*」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Did something happen?」

name: Synn
message: 「Nah, just savoring the taste of victory. Slurp...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Heh heh... Captivating innocent young girls--I'd expect nothing less」

name: Misa
message: 「D-D-Don't tell me you bribed them!?

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you talking about. There's no way Synn has the financial muscle for that」

name: Synn
message: 「Just say I wouldn't do something like that, normally」

name: Sally
message: 「Phew-- Dorayaki is so yummy~」

name: Ria
message: 「It tastes great when you have it with tea」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's bitter~」

name: Sally
message: 「You're such a kid, Lolo-chi~ Let's see here」

name: Sally
message: 「Gah, so bitter~」

name: Ria
message: 「This bitterness is what you'd call a mature taste」

name: Sally
message: 「I see~ Figures someone with huge boobs would know」

name: Ria
message: 「Th-That has nothing to do with it, Sally-chan\s03」

name: Sally
message: 「Haaah, they look so yummy~」

name: Ria
message: 「They're not food, bad girl」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Slurp...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President. Why are you looking off into the distance?」
I casually looked away, so don't call me out on it!

name: Sally
message: 「So if I clean, I get to eat dorayaki~~ Awesome~~\s07」
Sally-chan slumps onto the desk and lets out a voice full of bliss.

name: Ria
message: 「If you work even harder, maybe something even better will happen」

name: Synn
message: 「I knew it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't react to that!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「However, Extra-san still lacks devotion. You'll have to try much harder if you wish to stand shoulder-to-shoulder with me」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Heehee. You've finally come to understand my feelings. Being honest with yourself is a truly wonderful thing, you know」

name: Paqy
message: 「You heard her, Soba」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why me!? She obviously means Misa!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't pass it onto me!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I don't hear an answer」

name: Sally
message: 「Dorayaki's so yummy~ Zzz...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, she's asleep」

name: Misa
message: 「And while floating, too」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Good grief... She's such a child」
Saying that, Lolotte looks around restlessly.

name: Lolotte
message: 「What should we do... She'll catch a cold if we leave her like this」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Then I'll drape my jacket over her」

name: Sally
message: 「H... Heavy...」
Her expression suddenly turned grim.

name: Synn
message: 「Well, there's milk in it」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Take it out!!」

name: Misa
message: 「So, what are we going to do about this girl?」

name: Synn
message: 「We can't just leave her sleeping here, right」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not what I mean--I'm asking if we're going to keep having her help out with the Student Council」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She was actually working pretty normally, wasn't she」

name: Misa
message: 「How does she look to you, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「She did keep getting in the way, yes, but she properly got done what needed to be done」

name: Synn
message: 「True」

name: Lolotte
message: 「For today, let's give her credit as a bonus. With a heart as wide as the sky!」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, having extra hands certainly doesn't hurt...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What do you think, Advisor」

name: Ria
message: 「I think it's lively and fun\s04」

name: Sally
message: 「Oyabin~~ It's so yummy~~ mumble mumble」

name: Sally
message: 「Gasp--!?」

name: Sally
message: 「Crap, I completely forgot about Oyabin!」

name: Synn
message: 「You have to recycle cans and bottles, you know」

name: Sally
message: 「Thanks for the dorayaki! See ya later\s07」

name: Misa
message: 「What a busy girl」

name: Synn
message: 「Wonder when she'll come by next」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When she does, it looks like she'll fight with Lolo-chan again」

name: Ria
message: 「Lolotte is a big girl after all, right~?」

name: Misa
message: 「Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Zzz... zzz... dorayaki... mumble, mumble」

name: Synn
message: 「She was running around having a blast with Sally the whole time, after all」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Good grief. I can't tell which one is the real kid」
Everyone looked at each other and smiled.
